The components of the weathering profile can hence be classified in
terms of percentages of fresh rock, decomposed rock and soil (or void) as
has been done for other rocks (Table 3). In impure carbonate rocks all
the rock mass zones may be present, whereas in pure carbonate rocks a thin
layer of Residual Soil is usually underlain by Fresh Rock (Figure 5).

In the project area, the white and grey marble subunits of the Yuen
Long Formation are generally pure and only a thin (or missing) Residual
Soil layer is present, usually underlain by Fresh Rock without any
transition zones, In some cases, small cavities, partially or wholly
filled, are present below a very irregular karstic surface. All the zones
were seen to be present where the marble has been altered by intrusions
(Figure 4). In the interbedded marble and metasiltstone subunit underlying
some of the bridge sites, a gradual transition from a structureless sandy
silt (Residual Soil) to Fresh Rock occurs (Table 3, Plate 7).
